extracted.name: Chocolate martini
extracted.description: Enjoy a grown-up way to drink chocolate with this indulgent chocolate martini, a blend of Irish cream, coffee liqueur and vodka
instruction_lines: Dip a pastry brush into the melted chocolate and brush up the side of two glasses. Chill until set.
Pour the Irish cream liqueur, coffee liqueur, chocolate syrup and vodka into a shaker with a handful of ice and shake hard until the outside of the shaker feels very cold. Strain into the glasses.
